name: duraston-spike
description: DUR-1 feasibility spike: compile a representative astonagent agent loop (TS) to a Golem-compatible WASM component.

scripts.build:wasm: jco componentize dist/component.js --wit wit/agent.wit --world-name agent-worker --out dist/agent.wasm
scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:wasm
scripts.demo: jco transpile dist/agent.wasm -o dist/transpiled && node scripts/demo.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build:durable && npm run build:data && node --experimental-sqlite --test
